questions.question: Robin works with clients across 9 industries. Which of these is NOT one of them?
Robin is developing an AI-powered OCR tool. What kind of documents can it read?
Robin’s team is made of over 35 members. What backgrounds do they mostly come from?
Robin has delivered AI projects across multiple countries. Which of these is one of them?
What is the main difference between Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning?
options: ML is a subset of AI
AI is a subset of ML
They are the exact same thing
questions.correct_answer: ML is a subset of AI

questions.question: Which of these is an example of supervised learning?
options: Predicting house prices from historical data
Grouping customers by spending habits with no labels
Generating new art from random noise
questions.correct_answer: Predicting house prices from historical data

questions.question: In data science, the phrase “garbage in, garbage out” means:
options: If your data is poor, your model results will also be poor
Data scientists take out the trash daily
Models can magically fix broken data
questions.correct_answer: If your data is poor, your model results will also be poor

questions.question: Which of these AI achievements happened first?
options: AI beats world chess champion Garry Kasparov
AI writes a full-length movie script
questions.correct_answer: AI beats world chess champion Garry Kasparov
